subject: general
question:
**The statement below has been given with bracketed text. Select the option with correct Idiom for the bracketed text.**

History certainly gives you (something to think about), doesn't it?
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Food for thought**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**food for thought**" means something that gives you** something to think about or consider. **(कुछ सोचने या विचार करने योग्य)

 
 
• **Example**: *After reading that thought-provoking book, I had a lot of food for thought about the meaning of life.*
 
 
 
• The phrase is commonly used to refer to a topic or idea that is interesting or thought-provoking.
 
• The idiom is often used in discussions or debates to introduce a new perspective or idea.
 
• The phrase can also be used in a more literal sense, such as when someone is presented with new information or data to analyze.

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Cup of Joe**" is an idiom that means a cup of coffee. (एक कप कॉफी)
 
• "**Golden handshake**" is an idiom that refers to a large severance payment given to an employee upon leaving a company. (किसी कर्मचारी को कंपनी छोड़ने पर दिया जाने वाला एक बड़ा विच्छेद भुगतान)
 
• "**Forty winks**" is an idiom that means a short nap or sleep. (एक छोटी सी झपकी या नींद)
